item.title: Alex Ovechkin’s NHL goals record gets the Funko Pop treatment
item.description: Alex Ovechkin broke the NHL goals record on April 6 against the New York Islanders. Now, nearly a year later, one of the celebratory merch items made available for preorder that day is shipping out to buyers. Ovechkin's fourth Funko POP!, a Fanatics exclusive figurine, celebrates the Capitals legend becoming the NHL's all-time goals leader and features The Great 8's exclusive logo on the white, black and gold box.
